structuredContent.body:
A current published Bitcoin lesson retained a displayed-price-only sale description because its exact-text correction targeted the adjacent heading at body[6] instead of the paragraph at body[7]. Correct that index and align three related summaries with guest browser inputs versus signed-in server-selected quotes.

Preserves published database documents, financial examples and quiz keys/options. The new regression uses the current approved public snapshot: it fails before the fix and passes afterward, checks SSR/bootstrap parity, idempotence and later owner-edit preservation. Local Cloudflare build and its regression suite pass. Production closure remains pending exact-head protected CI, native Cloudflare receipt and live reread. Related to #430; keep the master audit open.
structuredContent.title: Fix skipped course sale disclosure and inconsistent execution summaries
